media.title: An agent builds, debugs, and checks an iOS weather app

title: Build and Debug an iOS App Through an Agent
summary: Cameron Cooke shows an agent using XcodeBuildMCP to add weather-alert controls, rebuild the app, diagnose a logic error, and visually check the resulting interface on an iPhone. An iOS team can pilot the same loop on a bounded feature and require build, runtime, and UI evidence before accepting the change.
takeaway: Give an agent one bounded feature, then require it to build, launch, debug, and visually verify the result rather than stopping at generated Swift code.
